text.tspan: How a small cup became part of everyday life.

svg.text: Why coffee is important in Vietnam

text.tspan: Coffee is not only something to drink. It is a place to sit, talk,
watch the street and give the day a little more time.

svg.text: Cho tôi một cà phê sữa đá.
Please give me an iced coffee with condensed milk.
Take your time. Vietnamese coffee is often a social pause.
